SUMMARY.official_code_title: RX8. RP9 RX8 FUNCTIONAL RELATION VALIDATOR
SUMMARY.principle: Function, relation, position and value are validated without geometric structure requirements.
SUMMARY.validation_boundary: Only the identities explicitly calculated by this code are claimed as validated.

TESTS.title: COMPLEMENTARY_VALUE_RELATION
TESTS.what_is_tested: The complementary value relation 1/4 and 3/4 within one preserved whole.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Uses exact rational arithmetic and checks both closure and complement.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To verify the relation as a value identity without assigning it to a geometric form.

TESTS.title: BINARY_SCALE_EXTENSION
TESTS.what_is_tested: Repeated binary scaling of one established value.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Applies the same division-by-two operation recursively with exact rational arithmetic.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To verify that later scale positions are generated by the same operation rather than by a new rule.

TESTS.title: SCALE_INVARIANT_COMPLEMENT
TESTS.what_is_tested: The 1/4 and 3/4 complementary relation under multiple exact scales.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Scales both positions by the same factor and checks closure and the 3:1 ratio.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To verify that scale changes the magnitude of the positions without changing their internal relation.
TESTS.expected_result: For every tested scale S: S/4 + 3S/4 = S and (3S/4)/(S/4) = 3.
TESTS.observed_result: Checked 4 exact scales; all preserved closure and ratio.

TESTS.title: SEVEN_PLUS_ONE_POSITION_RELATION
TESTS.what_is_tested: The positional value relation 7 + 1 within a total of 8.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Computes the total and the exact relative positions 7/8 and 1/8.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To verify the value relation independently of any geometric interpretation.

TESTS.title: REPRESENTATIONAL_PROJECTION
TESTS.what_is_tested: Projection of selected exact rational positions into machine decimal representation.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Converts exact rational values to float and records the exact recovered machine value and residual.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To keep exact functional values separate from their machine representation.
TESTS.expected_result: Every selected exact position is projected and its representation residual is explicitly recorded.
TESTS.observed_result: Projected 5 exact positions and recorded all residuals.

TESTS.title: INTERNAL_VALIDATION_LOCK
TESTS.what_is_tested: The combined status of TEST_1 through TEST_5 inside this validator.
TESTS.how_it_is_tested: Collects the five independent internal test results and requires all of them to PASS.
TESTS.why_it_is_tested: To provide one final status for this self-contained code without depending on another RP9 validator.
TESTS.expected_result: TEST_1 through TEST_5 must all be PASS.
